# llms.txt for w2crep.org
# Purpose: Provide guidance for AI systems, LLM crawlers, and content summarizers.

[site]
name = w2cReps
domain = https://w2crep.org
language = en
type = shopping guide / spreadsheet / product discovery resource

[summary]
w2crep.org is an independent shopping guide and product discovery website.
It provides curated finds, spreadsheet-style navigation, QC-photo-oriented shopping guidance, and educational content for users exploring Chinese e-commerce platforms and agent-based purchasing workflows.
The website does not directly sell products and is intended as an informational resource.

[content]
primary_topics = w2c finds, spreadsheet navigation, QC photos, shopping guides, product discovery, fashion categories, buying tutorials
audience = users looking for curated shopping links, buying guidance, and spreadsheet-based product browsing
content_format = homepage content, category navigation, shopping tutorial, informational sections
